historical_record.description: The Office of the Assessor-Recorder photographed the property for tax assessment. Parks Appliance and Service was at the address.
An existing two-story building with retail on the ground floor and two dwelling units on the second floor stood on the site.

The City Planning Commission approved the demolition of an existing two-story building and construction of a new four-story building with three parking spaces and three dwelling units, with conditions including no roof deck and a 15-foot setback.

unknowns: The assessor dates the building to 2003, after this photograph was taken.
